svg.title: Catalog-first (Option A): the chain from the rule to the claim and the result
svg.desc: A chain of 5 steps, each drawn as one row per relationship, with the field that holds the pointer on the left and the field it resolves to on the right. Step 1, rule to check, is made of 2 relationships. parts[assessment-method].props.TechnicalControlId in the catalog, which holds SV-270747r1066730_rule, name match to components[].title in the component-definition. implemented-requirements[].control-id in the component-definition, which holds UBTU-24-600090, reference to controls[].id in the catalog. Step 2, rule to control, is made of 2 relationships. maps[].sources[].id-ref in the mapping-collection, which holds UBTU-24-600090, reference to controls[].id in the catalog. maps[].targets[].id-ref in the mapping-collection, which holds sc-28, reference to controls[].id in the catalog. Step 3, check to runtime, is made of 1 relationship. components[].props.ConfigRuleId in the component-definition, which holds SV_270747R1066730_RULE, no join to no field in the nothing. Step 4, runtime to claim, is made of 2 relationships. implemented-requirements[].control-id in the system-security-plan, which holds UBTU-24-600090, reference to controls[].id in the catalog. by-components[].component-uuid in the system-security-plan, which holds 534b356b-0de1-48d4-8536-5d41ed717456, reference to system-implementation.components[].uuid in the system-security-plan. Step 5, claim to result, is made of 2 relationships. findings[].target.target-id in the assessment-results, which holds UBTU-24-600090_smt, reference to statements[].statement-id in the system-security-plan. related-observations[].observation-uuid in the assessment-results, which holds 28e28d31-4428-4ff5-8c9e-ea1198dfb552, reference to observations[].uuid in the assessment-results. Every value is rule 1, data at rest, as the six questions page encodes it for this approach.
